Amit Das transferred Rs 250000 to Suresh Roy through bank account ACC1001. The transaction occurred after a meeting near Park Street.
Suresh Roy travelled to Kolkata using vehicle WB12AB1234. He was seen meeting Arjun Singh.
Arjun Singh contacted Rahul Sharma multiple times using phone number 9876543210.
Amit Das and Arjun Singh were observed near Asansol Railway Station before a suspicious financial transaction.
Rahul Sharma transferred Rs 500000 to an unknown account ACC2002. Suresh Roy was present at the location.
Multiple calls were recorded between Amit Das and Suresh Roy before they met near Howrah Station.
Arjun Singh used vehicle WB12AB1234 and travelled from Durgapur to Asansol.
Rahul Sharma met an unidentified individual near City Centre. Phone number 9123456780 was active at the location.
Suresh Roy transferred Rs 300000 to account ACC1001 shortly after contacting Arjun Singh.
